body: This app continues to get enshitified. In 2026 I thought I could send an album to Google photos without any issues but that's not supported. Instead, I selected each individual image and uploaded them thinking they'd be easy to find under recently uploaded. They were not. They were mixed in with my thousands of other pictures, which I'm obviously not going to look through. I'm just going to use another platform to make an album in the cloud. Crazy Google photos can no longer do that with ease.

Fix Google Photos, PLZZZZ! It used to be my favorite, GO TO for photos until a few weeks ago. I'm an artist, photographer, and major ADHD - I have come to rely on GP so much it's almost 2nd skin, and saved me so much time & hassle.Now, I can't even find all of my photos, albums, etc. Most 🤬 is not being able to just pull up a photo and attach or insert anywhere. Just spent over 1 hr trying to find a photo I had taken of an order that the seller asked for me to upload a pic. (Still can't)

I like Google photos but the mobile app is a bit of a cluster compared to the more straightforward, less clustered desktop/PC version. Also, is there a reliable way for duplicate images to be axed without having to manually check to make sure you're not deleting both? I'm talking for like 100s+ of pictures. Thanks! edit 8/28/26, why are my photos not showing up in the big main page? Only some are, the rest are on Recently Added. Having to go dig for my most recent screenshots is nuts

The photos aren't lost, they are 6 yr old photos that are present in the Google Photos Cloud. I restored them to a phone so I may edit them and use them. Restored images are sitting on their original calendar dates instead of the top. How can you expect anyone using a photo editing app or other app to spend time scrolling through 2026 to 2020 images when they have a lot of images? It never used to be like this. Your links are not relevant to the issue. Something changed on the backend. Thanks

Google Photos makes it incredibly hard to organize my library when new photos come in from cloud sync tools like MultCloud. Every single new photo arrives “loose,” and I have to manually sort it into albums all over again when I already did this! Auto‑albums can’t be shared or used by smart frames, so they don’t help. Please give us a simple way to see photos not in any manual album, or a way to auto‑assign albums. This constant manual sorting is exhausting.

My photos are disappearing. I've been using Google Photos for years and even bought extra storage, but for the past four months, I've regretted not just getting a flash drive instead. Many of my photos have vanished, including ones that were very important to me and my family. It's particularly upsetting regarding photos from when my children were younger. Given all the issues with these companies, including their hacks and overall practices, this situation is really frustrating.

This app DOES NOT duplicate photos, so if you plan on keeping your photos in the original app you were using, you won't. All of my albums are missing photos because they were taken and placed into google photos, once restored all the photos are mixed together. Also when the photo is "stacked" it only restores one photo. I have over 7,000 photos I was transferring and now everything is so disorganized and there's no easy way to fix it without spending hours trying to figure it out. I am so upset!

Google Photos is and always has been a very great tool for managing your photo gallery and syncing it between devices. However, I'm not super fond of the AI stuff everywhere. I wish there was an opt-out toggle. If I want AI to edit my photos, I'll go to the Gemini app for that, not Google Photos, because AI doesn't belong there.

What happened to this app? Crashes every time I try to edit a video making the editing feature completely useless. Can't use any other apps at the same time (e.g. Spotify) because it will cause other apps to crash when you open Google photos. I will be cancelling my subscription and looking for storage from competitors soon since this was one of the reasons I started paying for it.

"Ever since the recent system update, the Android Media Picker has completely broken my photo sharing workflow. I regularly upload photos to third-party apps directly from my Google Photos cloud collections, but now my cloud library won't populate at all when trying to attach media. When I went to troubleshoot in my device settings, the 'Clear storage' and 'Clear cache' options for the Media Picker app were completely grayed out and locked.

Google photos is the only option my phone came with. It's been fine until this last update. Before the last update, when you opened the app your photos would be shown by month/year taken so you only needed to scroll down to see older ones. It was easy and organized. With the new update, the organization is gone. All photos/videos are now shown in a haphazard mess. Sad. This app came with the phone and cannot be deleted and replaced.

UGH. Now every time I edit a photo, I can't access it from any apps for some time. Google, are you looking at all of these reviews? Things used to work well. Now I frequently can't find photos and your links to "help" aren't helpful. Basic functionality should be prioritized over bells and whistles. The editing is awful, Magic Eraser doesn't work, AI editing is terrible, etc.

Loved Google Photos. Always demonstrating to people how easy it was to find a photo i.e. 'Dog in a hat'. Now the search has changed to AI and it's terrible. Even changing to classic, the same search will show your photo briefly, then change to 'Nothing found' or a huge list of random garbage. I cannot search anything. So sad. I have thousands of photos in storage. Google was my end all, be all.

It won't let me merge peoples labels or import my photos from Google drive. So after another few years of Google photos and drive, I'm about to give up on this service. It's good, yes. But expensive! The amount of duplicates I have of stuff and photos isn't easely mended either. Now that I'm trying to mend all of that and need to download all my stuff from both photos and drive, it's extremely difficult! For some reason Google hasn't got a select all photos! Google takeout is rubbish too.

Google Photos is one of the best apps for storing and organizing photos. It automatically backs up your images, offers powerful search features, and groups faces and places accurately. The editing tools are simple yet effective. The cloud storage helps free up space on your phone. Some features now require a subscription, but overall it’s a reliable and smart photo management app.

Used to love Google Photos, especially the Perspective tool that let me fix slanted angles and straighten lines. Now it's gone with the new update, and there's no substitute. Please bring it back. This was essential for editing architecture, scanned documents, and travel photos. Until then, 2 stars.

Easy to use and much improved over the years! After the oneui 7 update, the widgets have gone a bit weird and the photos don't resize to the size of the widget, if that makes sense. It's now this super narrow horizontal photo, which kind of defeats the purpose of having the photo widget! Is this a google photos issue or a software update issue?

Extremely aggressive in trying to get me to back up my photos, turned on auto-backup without my knowing, but what's most annoying is when I deleted from google photos to free up space, it also deleted the same items from my phone. I'm mad and disappointed, I want to be able to delete from one while keeping the other. What's the point of a separate storage space if it forces me to have all the same things stored?
